final: WITH patient_avgs AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_got) AS mean_patient_avg_got FROM patient_avgs) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc, p.avg_got - o.mean_patient_avg_got AS difference FROM patient_avgs AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_patient_avg_got IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
